{"timestamp":"2026-10-16T08:02:17.877Z","ordinal":5,"type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","id":"msg_01a143bb-b694-7510-a9c2-e9b42ebb5e55","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"# AGENTS.md instructions for D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13\n\n<INSTRUCTIONS>\n# HarmonyOS NEXT 开发核心规则与最佳实践\r\n\r\n本文档基于 Huawei 开发者官方文档及社区最佳实践整理，适用于 HarmonyOS NEXT (API 12+) 开发。\r\n\r\n## 1. ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\r\n\r\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\r\n\r\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\r\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\r\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\r\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\r\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\r\n\r\n### 1.2 语法限制\r\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\r\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\r\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\r\n\r\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\r\n\r\n### 2.1 组件化设计\r\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\r\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\r\n\r\n### 2.2 状态管理\r\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\r\n- **装饰器选择**：\r\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\r\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\r\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\r\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\r\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享。\r\n- **更新机制**：状态变量必须通过赋值更新，不要直接修改对象属性（除非使用 `@Observed` 和 `@ObjectLink` 处理嵌套对象）。\r\n\r\n### 2.3 布局与样式\r\n- **单位**：统一使用 `vp` (虚拟像素) 和 `fp` (字体像素)，禁止硬编码 `px`。\r\n- **布局性能**：\r\n  - 减少布局嵌套层级（特别是 `Stack` 和 `Flex` 的深层嵌套）。\r\n  - 优先使用 `RelativeContainer` 替代复杂的嵌套布局。\r\n  - 列表渲染必须使用 `LazyForEach`，并提供唯一的 `keyGenerator`，避免全量重绘。\r\n- **自适应**：使用断点 (`GridRow`/`GridCol`) 和媒体查询适配多设备屏幕。\r\n\r\n## 3. 性能优化指南\r\n\r\n### 3.1 渲染性能\r\n- **LazyForEach**：长列表数据必须使用 `LazyForEach` 加载，配合 `cachedCount` 预加载。\r\n- **条件渲染**：频繁切换显隐建议使用 `visibility` 属性控制，而非 `if/else`（后者会触发生命周期）。\r\n- **图片优化**：加载大图时使用 `Image` 组件的 `sourceSize` 属性进行解码尺寸裁剪，避免内存浪费。\r\n\r\n### 3.2 并发与异步\r\n- **主线程减负**：耗时操作（IO、复杂计算、网络请求）必须移至后台线程。\r\n- **TaskPool**：优先使用 `TaskPool` 处理短时任务，系统会自动管理线程生命周期。\r\n- **Worker**：适用于长时间运行的后台任务。\r\n- **Promise**：异步操作统一使用 Promise 或 async/await，避免回调地狱。\r\n\r\n### 3.3 内存管理\r\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\r\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\r\n\r\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\r\n\r\n### 4.1 目录结构\r\n```text\r\nentry/src/main/ets/\r\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\r\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\r\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\r\n├── utils/          # 工具类\r\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\r\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\r\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\r\n```\r\n\r\n### 4.2 命名规范\r\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\r\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\r\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., `MAX_RETRY_COUNT`)\r\n- **文件命名**：与主要导出内容一致，组件文件通常 PascalCase，工具文件 camelCase。\r\n\r\n### 4.3 Kit 使用\r\n- 优先使用 HarmonyOS 内置 Kit (如 `ArkData` 用于数据库, `NetworkKit` 用于网络, `ArkUI` 用于界面)。\r\n- 引入第三方库前需确认其是否支持 HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS 兼容性)。\r\n\r\n## 5. 安全与隐私\r\n\r\n- **权限最小化**：仅申请业务必须的权限 (`module.json5`)。\r\n- **用户授权**：运行时敏感权限必须向用户动态申请。\r\n- **数据安全**：\r\n  - 敏感数据（Token、密码）存储使用 `WebDavCrypto` 或系统级 `KeyStore`。\r\n  - 本地数据库优先使用 `RdbStore` 或 `Preferences` 并加密。\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 本题自动调度\r\n\r\n题号：vg-spec13\r\n\r\n本题根目录：D:/HCUP/vg-spec13\r\n\r\n主 Agent 开始/继续作答时加载 `D:/HarmonyDev/codex/skills/harmony-task-flow/SKILL.md`，读取 workflow/state.json，调度四个角色并按失败证据回退。\r\n\r\n子 Agent 仅完成收到的派工，不自行成为调度者或创建子 Agent。仅使用本题 inputs、project 和记录；禁止其他题工程及相关上游修复历史。\r\n\r\n## HCUP 工作区布局与阶段\r\n\r\n本题工程根就是当前目录；workflow/state.json 的 project 指向当前目录，不要再创建 project 子目录，也不要使用 Skill 示例中的另一套工程路径。\r\n\r\n本题需求读取 spec/requirement.md，元数据读取 spec/metadata.json；inputs/ 保留原始输入副本。公共资源只读访问 ../common/，不得访问其他赛题目录。\r\n\r\n开始构建或设备命令前加载 D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1。\r\n\r\n本次仅完成独立工程准备；尚未分析需求、设计方案或实现功能。正式作答从本目录的新会话开始，登记新会话后再按四角色流程推进。\r\n\r\n初始化总览会话也包含公共环境、官方示例与其他题的工程准备内容，不能将其视为本题功能开发证据；后续需求和编码角色不要读取该总览会话作为实现参考。\r\n\n</INSTRUCTIONS>"},{"type":"input_text","text":"<environment_context>\n  <cwd>D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13</cwd>\n  <shell>powershell</shell>\n  <current_date>2026-10-16</current_date>\n  <timezone>Asia/Shanghai</timezone>\n  <filesystem><workspace_roots><root>D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13</root><root>C:\\Users\\22580\\.codex\\visualizations\\2026\\10\\16\\01a143b8-b8fa-7491-a22c-c0e5faed0de0</root></workspace_roots><permission_profile type=\"disabled\"><file_system type=\"unrestricted\" /></permission_profile></filesystem>\n</environment_context>"}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a143bb-a1b8-75e2-90e9-1b83c2d034c4","create_time":1792137737.87681,"content_item_kinds":["agents_md.instructions","environments.environment_context"]}}}

ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\r\n\r\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\r\n\r\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\r\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\r\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\r\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\r\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\r\n\r\n### 1.2 语法限制\r\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\r\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\r\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\r\n\r\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\r\n\r\n### 2.1 组件化设计\r\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\r\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\r\n\r\n### 2.2 状态管理\r\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\r\n- **装饰器选择**：\r\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\r\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\r\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\r\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\r\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享。\r\n- **更新机制**：状态变量必须通过赋值更新，不要直接修改对象属性（除非使用 `@Observed` 和 `@ObjectLink` 处理嵌套对象）。\r\n\r\n### 2.3 布局与样式\r\n- **单位**：统一使用 `vp` (虚拟像素) 和 `fp` (字体像素)，禁止硬编码 `px`。\r\n- **布局性能**：\r\n  - 减少布局嵌套层级（特别是 `Stack` 和 `Flex` 的深层嵌套）。\r\n  - 优先使用 `RelativeContainer` 替代复杂的嵌套布局。\r\n  - 列表渲染必须使用 `LazyForEach`，并提供唯一的 `keyGenerator`，避免全量重绘。\r\n- **自适应**：使用断点 (`GridRow`/`GridCol`) 和媒体查询适配多设备屏幕。\r\n\r\n## 3. 性能优化指南\r\n\r\n### 3.1 渲染性能\r\n- **LazyForEach**：长列表数据必须使用 `LazyForEach` 加载，配合 `cachedCount` 预加载。\r\n- **条件渲染**：频繁切换显隐建议使用 `visibility` 属性控制，而非 `if/else`（后者会触发生命周期）。\r\n- **图片优化**：加载大图时使用 `Image` 组件的 `sourceSize` 属性进行解码尺寸裁剪，避免内存浪费。\r\n\r\n### 3.2 并发与异步\r\n- **主线程减负**：耗时操作（IO、复杂计算、网络请求）必须移至后台线程。\r\n- **TaskPool**：优先使用 `TaskPool` 处理短时任务，系统会自动管理线程生命周期。\r\n- **Worker**：适用于长时间运行的后台任务。\r\n- **Promise**：异步操作统一使用 Promise 或 async/await，避免回调地狱。\r\n\r\n### 3.3 内存管理\r\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\r\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\r\n\r\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\r\n\r\n### 4.1 目录结构\r\n```text\r\nentry/src/main/ets/\r\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\r\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\r\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\r\n├── utils/          # 工具类\r\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\r\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\r\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\r\n```\r\n\r\n### 4.2 命名规范\r\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\r\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\r\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., `MAX_RETRY_COUNT`)\r\n- **文件命名**：与主要导出内容一致，组件文件通常 PascalCase，工具文件 camelCase。\r\n\r\n### 4.3 Kit 使用\r\n- 优先使用 HarmonyOS 内置 Kit (如 `ArkData` 用于数据库, `NetworkKit` 用于网络, `ArkUI` 用于界面)。\r\n- 引入第三方库前需确认其是否支持 HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS 兼容性)。\r\n\r\n## 5. 安全与隐私\r\n\r\n- **权限最小化**：仅申请业务必须的权限 (`module.json5`)。\r\n- **用户授权**：运行时敏感权限必须向用户动态申请。\r\n- **数据安全**：\r\n  - 敏感数据（Token、密码）存储使用 `WebDavCrypto` 或系统级 `KeyStore`。\r\n  - 本地数据库优先使用 `RdbStore` 或 `Preferences` 并加密。\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 本题自动调度\r\n\r\n题号：vg-spec13\r\n\r\n本题根目录：D:/HCUP/vg-spec13\r\n\r\n主 Agent 开始/继续作答时加载 `D:/HarmonyDev/codex/skills/harmony-task-flow/SKILL.md`，读取 workflow/state.json，调度四个角色并按失败证据回退。\r\n\r\n子 Agent 仅完成收到的派工，不自行成为调度者或创建子 Agent。仅使用本题 inputs、project 和记录；禁止其他题工程及相关上游修复历史。\r\n\r\n## HCUP 工作区布局与阶段\r\n\r\n本题工程根就是当前目录；workflow/state.json 的 project 指向当前目录，不要再创建 project 子目录，也不要使用 Skill 示例中的另一套工程路径。\r\n\r\n本题需求读取 spec/requirement.md，元数据读取 spec/metadata.json；inputs/ 保留原始输入副本。公共资源只读访问 ../common/，不得访问其他赛题目录。\r\n\r\n开始构建或设备命令前加载 D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1。\r\n\r\n本次仅完成独立工程准备；尚未分析需求、设计方案或实现功能。正式作答从本目录的新会话开始，登记新会话后再按四角色流程推进。\r\n\r\n初始化总览会话也包含公共环境、官方示例与其他题的工程准备内容，不能将其视为本题功能开发证据；后续需求和编码角色不要读取该总览会话作为实现参考。\r\n"},"apps_instructions":false,"collaboration_mode":{"mode":"default","model":"gpt-6.1-sol","instructions":"0a11049b0421e1e86f1e129af8d547a89548a0c3"},"context_window_guidance":"","environments":{"environments":{"local":{"cwd":"D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13","status":"available","shell":"powershell"}},"current_date":"2026-10-16","timezone":"Asia/Shanghai","filesystem":"<filesystem><workspace_roots><root>D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13</root><root>C:\\Users\\22580\\.codex\\visualizations\\2026\\10\\16\\01a143b8-b8fa-7491-a22c-c0e5faed0de0</root></workspace_roots><permission_profile type=\"disabled\"><file_system type=\"unrestricted\" /></permission_profile></filesystem>"},"environments_instructions":false,"git_attribution":false,"host_skills":{"body":"\n## Skills\nA skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Get-Content -Raw 'C:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/arkts-syntax-assistant/SKILL.md'; Get-Content -Raw 'C:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever/SKILL.md'"}],"source":"unified_exec_startup","status":"completed","aggregated_output":"01a143bb-a10f-7601-a510-405d234afe12\r\n# WebDAV 备份进度提示与实际操作保持一致\n\n## 场景一：手动备份显示加载指示器\n\n### 场景概述\n\n用户点击「立即备份」后，WebDAV 配置页必须在备份操作仍在运行时渲染 ArkUI `LoadingProgress` 加载指示器。\n\n### 操作步骤与预期结果\n\n1. 用户进入 WebDAV 配置页，并填写可访问的 WebDAV 配置。\n2. 用户点击「立即备份」按钮。\n3. 页面进入备份忙碌状态。\n4. 页面显示 ArkUI `LoadingProgress` 加载指示器。\n\n## 场景二：手动备份显示忙碌文案\n\n### 场景概述\n\n备份期间，页面必须展示「正在...」或「处理中...」一类的状态提示文字，让用户能够区分正在工作和空闲状态。\n\n### 操作步骤与预期结果\n\n1. 用户点击「立即备份」。\n2. 页面进入备份忙碌状态。\n3. 页面显示操作进行中的状态提示。\n4. 该文案在备份操作进行期间可见。\n\n## 场景三：手动备份向 WebDAV 服务端发送请求\n\n### 场景概述\n\n加载状态必须绑定真实的 WebDAV 操作。备份流程在忙碌状态可见时，必须向配置的 WebDAV 端点发送请求。\n\n### 操作步骤与预期结果\n\n1. 用户点击「立即备份」。\n2. 页面显示备份加载状态。\n3. 应用向配置的 WebDAV 服务端发送请求。\n4. 如果只出现加载状态而没有 WebDAV 请求，则该功能点不满足要求。\n\r\n# vg-spec13 验收矩阵（仅分析）\n\n## 1. 范围、快照与证据规则\n\n- 输入：`spec/requirement.md`、`spec/metadata.json`、`spec-harness/0-analyze.md`，以及本题未修改基线源码。未读取其他赛题、题包、上游功能版本或修复历史。\n- 元数据 `base_commit`：`88db8789e28333c7b7dcc8db078f394a262b73c3`。本文源码位置均由 `git show <base_commit>:<本题路径>` 读取，只表示该基线的静态事实；运行证据由 `spec/baseline-notes.md` 单独承担。\n- Spec SHA256：`ba156110d18109eecd2627ab66690b293da6cac504caef6650333a9a6e124677`，本角色已重新计算核对。\n- 需求角色真实会话标识：`CODEX_THREAD_ID=01a1438c-25bf-7831-93ca-1b4ade7410ee`，直接读取该环境变量；未使用继承的 `CODEX_SESSION_ID`。\n- 本角色只创建此文档；没有修改业务代码、测试、workflow 状态，也没有执行构建或设备命令。本文列出的检查均为验收设计，不能视为已通过。\n- `SPEC_EXPLICIT`：Spec 明文。`REASONABLE_DERIVATION`：为解释明文而提出的可检验推导，不能作为新增 Spec 明文。`UNCONFIRMED_ASSUMPTION`：Spec 没有决定的产品策略，必须保留分支，不能按推荐方案擅自判失败。\n- 代码实证另标 `BASELINE_CODE`；它解释现状，不会把基线行为提升为产品要求。\n- 数量：**16 个明文原子项 A01–A16、7 个推导原子项 D01–D07、28 个边界探针 B01–B28、10 个待确认策略 U01–U10**。同一行为在不同场景重复列出是为了逐步骤追溯；这些数量均不代表官方 F-point 数量或分值。\n\n## 2. 的终结恢复来自推导；U 代表未决策略。\n\n```mermaid\nstateDiagram-v2\n    [*] --> Idle\n    Idle --> Configured: 进入并填写可访问配置 A01/A02\n    Configured --> BackupRunning: 点击立即备份 A03/A07/A11\n    state BackupRunning {\n        [*] --> Preparing\n        Preparing --> RequestInFlight: 发出真实WebDAV请求 A13/A14\n        RequestInFlight --> MoreWork: 响应后流程仍未结束\n        MoreWork --> RequestInFlight: 如有后续真实请求\n        MoreWork --> Finished: 实际操作完成\n        RequestInFlight --> Finished: 最终响应使操作终结\n    }\n    BackupRunning --> Success: 真实操作成功结束 D01\n    BackupRunning --> Failed: 失败结果或异常终结 D02/D03\n    Success --> Idle: 清理busy/进行中UI D01\n    Failed --> Idle: finally等效清理 D02/D03\n    BackupRunning --> LeftPage: 返回或关闭 U06/U07\n    LeftPage --> Configured: 重进时恢复策略待确认 U07\n    BackupRunning --> ProcessStopped: 强制退出或重启 U08\n    ProcessStopped --> Configured: 重启后策略待确认 U08\n```\n\n绑定规则：A05/A06 要求备份运行时存在可见 `LoadingProgress`；A09/A10 要求同期间进行中文字可见；A16 要求同一忙碌可见流程发送真实请求。Preparing 包括导出、加密或请求准备，**不要求从点击开始的每一瞬间都已有请求**。用网络延迟制造一个可观察的运行窗口；不能用计时器做一个没有真实备份的假加载。\n\nSpec 未要求某种 HTTP 方法、固定请求数、固定文件名、服务端必须成功、百分比进度、固定显示时长或上传后恢复路由。它要求真实备份操作中的真实 WebDAV 请求；仅伪造 console、请求无关 URL 或只更改 UI 都不能当成满足。对于“仅预检而无上传是否足够”，保留 U02，不擅自扩大明文。\n\n### 6.2 基线真实调用链与超时分叉（BASELINE_CODE）\n\n```mermaid\nstateDiagram-v2\n    [*] --> UIIdle\n    UIIdle --> UIBusy: 点击备份，guard通过 C4\n    UIBusy --> ManagerCheck: busy=true，写正在备份到云端，等待50ms\n    ManagerCheck --> FinalUI: 配置缺失或已有SYNCING，返回失败 C6/C7\n    ManagerCheck --> Preflight: manager置SYNCING\n    Preflight --> Export: 缓存或目录可达/准备完成 C8\n    Preflight --> FinalUI: 预检返回失败，manager=ERROR\n    Preflight --> OuterCatch: 预检抛异常，未进manager的try\n    Export --> EncryptTask: 导出成功 C7\n    Export --> ManagerFinally: 导出失败或try内异常\n    EncryptTask --> ParentCheck: 加密成功 C9\n    EncryptTask --> ManagerFinally: 加密失败\n    ParentCheck --> BackupPUT: 可能HEAD及PUT .keep C10\n    BackupPUT --> ManagerFinally: HTTP结果或任务失败 C9\n    ManagerFinally --> FinalUI: manager=IDLE，返回结果 C7\n    OuterCatch --> FinalUI: UI包装catch处理 C4\n    FinalUI --> UIIdle: 写结果，UI finally busy=false C4\n    UIBusy --> UITimedOut: 外层Promise.race达到120000ms C4\n    UITimedOut --> UIIdle: UI写异常并finally解除busy\n    UITimedOut --> IOStillPossible: 无取消底层Promise的代码\n    IOStillPossible --> LateCompletion: 原操作以后才完成，可能有远端副作用\n```\n\n读取此图时必须区分两个时钟：**UI 等待 Promise 已拒绝**，不证明**底层 I/O 已取消**。外层超时后 spinner 是否必须继续显示、能否发起下一轮、晚到成功如何呈现，Spec 未作规定，见 U06；此处只列基线风险。C4 UI finally 不能证明 manager 也始终复位；C7 预检抛错发生在 manager try/finally 外。不得在分析阶段修复，也不得把这些附加风险一律标成官方功能失败。\n\n基\n... command output truncated for 子分区本地状态：`webdavResult`、`webdavBackupResult`、`webdavBusy`（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:41)）。手动备份包装器先检查 busy，再置 busy、赋值“正在备份到云端...”、等待 50ms、等待真实异步操作，`finally` 清 Spec 缺失能力与逐场景基线判定\n\n`SPEC_EXPLICIT`：[requirement.md](requirement.md:7) 要求备份进行时渲染 ArkUI `LoadingProgress`；[场景二](requirement.md:20) 要求进行中的文字；[场景三](requirement.md:33) 要求加载状态绑定真实请求。\n\n| Spec 场景/步骤 | 基线判定 | 证据范围 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 场景一 1：进入并填写可访问配置 | `pass` | 本次合成端点保存成功，服务端收到有效认证的请求；不是任意配置皆可用 |\n| 场景一 2–3：点击“立即备份”，进入忙碌 | `pass` | [observe-backup.log](../logs/baseline-20261016/observe-backup.log:1)、07/08/09/10 UI 树和截图 |\n| 场景一 4：忙碌期间显示 ArkUI `LoadingProgress` | **`fail`** | 07/08/09/10 UI 树 `LoadingProgress` 均为 0；09 截图无指示器；备份分区源码未构造该组件 |\n| 场景二 1–4：备份操作期间显示忙碌文案 | `pass`，仅本次已保存合成配置的单次成功路径 | 多次离散采样都有五个“处理中...”和“正在备份到云端...”；未证明所有异常/生命周期路径 |\n| 场景三 1–4：忙碌状态绑定真实 WebDAV 请求 | `pass`，仅本次已保存合成配置的单次成功路径 | 主机同一 UTC 时钟记录的 09 采样完整落在 PUT 的 received/responded 之间；下列最小复现和时间线 |\n| 成功后结果及恢复（合理推导的观察） | `pass`，单次 | [11-settled.json](../logs/baseline-20261016/11-settled.json:1) / PNG：五个按钮重新 enabled，显示“✅ 备份已上传” |\n| 仅填写未保存就点击备份 | `not_run` | 仅保存了 04 未保存配置截图，**没有在未保存状态点击备份**。代码路径见下 |\n| 空值/纯空格、无配置、错误认证、HTTP 失败/超时、快速连点、取消/关闭、返回重进、重启、操作中离开、不同数据量 | `not_run` | 本次只做未修改基线摸底，不把静态阅读或成功路径外推为通过 |\n\n没有设备/签名环境 `blocked`；整题仍有明确 `fail`，不得将编译成功计为整题通过。\n\n最小失败复现：\n\n1. 安装上述哈希的基线 HAP，启动并按第 3 节进入目标分区。\n2. 启动 [webdav-fixture.py](../logs/baseline-20261016/webdav-fixture.py:1)，使用 `hdc -t 127.0.0.1:5555 rport tcp:18173 tcp:18173` 将设备端口转发至本机。fixture 对 HEAD 返回 200；收到备份 PUT 后等待 8 秒，返回 201。\n3. 的服务端和采样日志，没有直接混用 hilog 墙钟。\n\n## 7. 前置环境、受控服务与清理\n\n- `RUNTIME_OBSERVED`：设备 `127.0.0.1:5555`，软件 `emulator 6.1.0.115(SP11DEVC00E115R4P11)`，API `23`，分辨率 `1308×2880`。DevEco 环境脚本显示 6.1.0.860；工程目标/兼容 SDK 是 Triggers on: .ets files, ArkTS keywords, HarmonyOS/OpenHarmony context, @ohos packages.\r\n  Help with syntax reference, TypeScript migration, performance optimization,\r\n  compile errors, state management, component development, and language-specific questions.\r\nlicense: MIT\r\ntags:\r\n  - arkts\r\n  - harmonyos\r\n  - typescript\r\n  - migration\r\n  - development\r\n  - syntax\r\n---\r\n\r\n# ArkTS Syntax Assistant\r\n\r\n[中文文档](SKILL.zh.md)\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Overview\r\n\r\nArkTS is the default development language for OpenHarmony applications. It builds\r\nupon TypeScript with enhanced static typing to improve program stability and\r\nperformance.\r\n\r\n## Core Features\r\n\r\n- **Static Typing**: All types determined at compile time, reducing runtime checks\r\n- **No Dynamic Object Layout**: Object structure fixed at compile time, cannot be\r\n  modified at runtime\r\n- **Restricted Operators**: Some operator behaviors are restricted to encourage\r\n  clearer code semantics\r\n- **No Structural Typing**: Structural typing is currently not supported\r\n\r\n## Reference Documentation\r\n\r\n| Scenario | Document |\r\n|----------|----------|\r\n| Syntax Learning | [references/en/introduction-to-arkts.md](references/en/introduction-to-arkts.md) |\r\n| Quick Overview | [references/en/arkts-get-started.md](references/en/arkts-get-started.md) |\r\n| TS Migration | [references/en/typescript-to-arkts-migration-guide.md](references/en/typescript-to-arkts-migration-guide.md) |\r\n| Migration Background | [references/en/arkts-migration-background.md](references/en/arkts-migration-background.md) |\r\n| Performance | [references/en/arkts-high-performance-programming.md](references/en/arkts-high-performance-programming.md) |\r\n| More Cases | [references/en/arkts-more-cases.md](references/en/arkts-more-cases.md) |\r\n\r\n## Workflows\r\n\r\n### 1. Syntax Questions\r\n\r\n```\r\nUser Question -> Identify Question Type -> Consult Documentation -> Provide Code Example\r\n```\r\n\r\n**Common Syntax Questions**:\r\n- Variable declaration -> Use `let`/`const` with explicit type or inference\r\n- Function definition -> Supports optional parameters, defaults, rest parameters,\r\n  arrow functions\r\n- Classes and interfaces -> Must initialize fields, supports inheritance and\r\n  implementation\r\n- Generics -> Supports constraints and default values\r\n- Null safety -> Nullable types ((T | null)), non-null assertion ((!)), optional\r\n  chaining ((?.))\r\n\r\n### 2. TypeScript Migration\r\n\r\n```\r\nIdentify TS Code -> Check Incompatible Features -> Consult Migration Rules -> Provide ArkTS Alternative\r\n```\r\n\r\n**Key Migration Rules Quick Reference**:\r\n\r\n| TypeScript | ArkTS Alternative |\r\n|------------|-------------------|\r\n| `var x` | `let x` |\r\n| `any`/`unknown` | Specific types |\r\n| `{n: 42}` object literal | Define class/interface first |\r\n| `[index: T]: U` index signature | `Record<T, U>` |\r\n| `A & B` intersection type | `interface C extends A, B` |\r\n| `function(){}` function expression | `() => {}` arrow function |\r\n| `<Type>value` type assertion | `value as Type` |\r\n| Destructuring `[a, b] = arr` | Individual access `arr[0]`, `arr[1]` |\r\n| `for..in` | `for` loop or `for..of` |\r\n| Constructor parameter properties | Explicit field declaration |\r\n\r\n### 3. Performance Optimization\r\n\r\n```\r\nAnalyze Code -> Identify Performance Issues -> Consult Optimization Guide -> Provide Solutions\r\n```\r\n\r\n**High-Performance Programming Key Points**:\r\n\r\n- **Declarations**: Use `const` for invariants; avoid mixing integer and float\r\n- **Loops**: Extract loop invariants; avoid numeric overflow\r\n- **Functions**: Parameter passing preferred over closures; avoid optional\r\n  parameters\r\n- **Arrays**: Use TypedArray for numeric values; avoid sparse arrays and union\r\n  type arrays\r\n- **Exceptions**: Avoid throwing in loops; use return values instead\r\n\r\n### 4. Compile Error Resolution\r\n\r\n```\r\nGet Error Message -> Search Migration Rules -> Find Related Case -> Provide Fix\r\n```\r\n\r\n## Common Questions\r\n\r\n### Q: How to handle JSON.parse return value?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Error\r\nlet data = JSON.parse(str);\r\n\r\n// Correct\r\nlet data: Record<string, Object> = JSON.parse(str);\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to define object types?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// TypeScript syntax (not supported in ArkTS)\r\ntype Person = { name: string, age: number }\r\n\r\n// ArkTS syntax\r\ninterface Person {\r\n  name: string;\r\n  age: number;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// Using object literal\r\nlet p: Person = { name: 'John', age: 25 };\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to replace globalThis?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Error\r\nglobalThis.value = 'xxx';\r\n\r\n// Use singleton pattern\r\nexport class GlobalContext {\r\n  private constructor() {}\r\n  private static instance: GlobalContext;\r\n  private _objects = new Map<string, Object>();\r\n\r\n  public static getContext(): GlobalContext {\r\n    if (!GlobalContext.instance) {\r\n      GlobalContext.instance = new GlobalContext();\r\n    }\r\n    return GlobalContext.instance;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  getObject(key: string): Object | undefined {\r\n    return this._objects.get(key);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  setObject(key: string, value: Object): void {\r\n    this._objects.set(key, value);\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to handle error types in catch?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Error\r\ntry {} catch (e: BusinessError) {}\r\n\r\n// Correct\r\ntry {} catch (error) {\r\n  let e: BusinessError = error as BusinessError;\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to use Record type?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// TypeScript index signature\r\nfunction foo(data: { [key: string]: string }) {}\r\n\r\n// ArkTS Record\r\nfunction foo(data: Record<string, string>) {}\r\n\r\n// Usage example\r\nlet map: Record<string, number> = {\r\n  'John': 25,\r\n  'Mary': 21,\r\n};\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to replace constructor signatures with factory functions?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// TypeScript constructor signature\r\ntype ControllerCtor = {\r\n  new (value: string): Controller;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ArkTS factory function\r\ntype ControllerFactory = () => Controller;\r\n\r\nclass Menu {\r\n  createController: ControllerFactory = () => {\r\n    return new Controller('default');\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n## Prohibited Standard Library APIs\r\n\r\nThe following are prohibited in ArkTS:\r\n\r\n- **Global**: `eval`\r\n- **Object**: `__proto__`, `defineProperty`, `freeze`, `getPrototypeOf`, etc.\r\n- **Reflect**: `apply`, `construct`, `defineProperty`, etc.\r\n- **Proxy**: All handler methods\r\n\r\n## Build Scripts\r\n\r\nThe scripts directory provides quick compilation scripts for ArkTS projects\r\n(including dependency installation):\r\n\r\n| Platform | Script | Purpose |\r\n|----------|--------|---------|\r\n| macOS/Linux | `scripts/run.sh` | Execute `ohpm install` + `hvigorw assembleApp` |\r\n| Windows | `scripts/run.ps1` | Execute `ohpm install` + `hvigorw assembleApp` |\r\n\r\nUsage:\r\n```bash\r\n# macOS/Linux\r\nbash scripts/run.sh\r\n\r\n# Windows PowerShell\r\n.\\scripts\\run.ps1\r\n```\r\n\r\nScript execution steps:\r\n1. Install dependencies (`ohpm install --all`)\r\n2. Build project (`hvigorw assembleApp`)\r\n\r\n## Mandatory Requirements\r\n\r\n**CRITICAL**: When this skill generates ArkTS code, the following workflow MUST be followed:\r\n\r\n1. **Compilation Verification**: After generating code, you MUST compile the project using the build scripts:\r\n   - macOS/Linux: `bash scripts/run.sh`\r\n   - Windows: `.\\scripts\\run.ps1`\r\n\r\n2. **Retry Strategy**: If compilation fails:\r\n   - Analyze the error output\r\n   - Fix the issue and retry compilation\r\n   - Maximum of **3 compilation attempts**\r\n\r\n3. **User Intervention**: After 3 failed compilation attempts, use `AskUserQuestion`:\r\n   ```\r\n   Question: Compilation failed after 3 attempts. How would you like to proceed?\r\n   Options:\r\n   - Continue retrying (attempt another fix)\r\n   - Manual intervention (I'll wait for your guidance)\r\n   - Skip compilation (proceed without verification)\r\n   ```\r\n\r\n4. **Error Reporting**: Always show the full compilation error output when failures occur.\r\n\r\n## Answer Guidelines\r\n\r\n1. **Prioritize code examples**: Show correct vs incorrect syntax comparison\r\n2. **Reference official documentation**: For detailed explanations, guide users to\r\n   consult corresponding documents in references/\r\n3. **Explain reasons**: Explain why ArkTS has this restriction (performance,\r\n   stability)\r\n4. **Provide alternatives**: For unsupported features, provide feasible\r\n  alternatives\r\n\r\n## License\r\n\r\nMIT License - see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)\r\n\r\n---\r\nname: hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever\r\ndescription: Retrieve grounded ArkTS references for pure non-UI ArkTS work and ArkTS API usage. Use this skill whenever the user is writing, reviewing, testing, validating, running, or debugging ArkTS code and the answer should be backed by repository sources such as `docs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/`, `docs/ArkTS-API-Reference/`, the linter-derived `docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md`, and the bundled lightweight lint tool docs `docs/linter/linter-cli.md` plus `linter-cli/` instead of model memory. This skill is especially useful for syntax rules, ArkTS-specific restrictions, API/module/member lookup, common-library usage, lightweight lint workflow lookup, runnable example lookup, snippet validation context, and figuring out which repository section to trust before suggesting code or fixes.\r\n---\r\n\r\n# ArkTS Retrieval Skill\r\n\r\nUse this skill to find real ArkTS documentation quickly and return traceable references.\r\n\r\nThis skill is for retrieval. syntax\r\n---\r\n\r\n# ArkTS Syntax Assistant\r\n\r\n[中文文档](SKILL.zh.md)\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Overview\r\n\r\nArkTS is the default development language for OpenHarmony applications. It builds\r\nupon TypeScript with enhanced static typing to improve program stability and\r\nperformance.\r\n\r\n## Core Features\r\n\r\n- **Static Typing**: All types determined at compile time, reducing runtime checks\r\n- **No Dynamic Object Layout**: Object structure fixed at compile time, cannot be\r\n  modified at runtime\r\n- **Restricted Operators**: Some operator behaviors are restricted to encourage\r\n  clearer code semantics\r\n- **No Structural Typing**: Structural typing is currently not supported\r\n\r\n## Reference Documentation\r\n\r\n| Scenario | Document |\r\n|----------|----------|\r\n| Syntax Learning | [references/en/introduction-to-arkts.md](references/en/introduction-to-arkts.md) |\r\n| Quick Overview | [references/en/arkts-get-started.md](references/en/arkts-get-started.md) |\r\n| TS Migration | [references/en/typescript-to-arkts-migration-guide.md](references/en/typescript-to-arkts-migration-guide.md) |\r\n| Migration Background | [references/en/arkts-migration-background.md](references/en/arkts-migration-background.md) |\r\n| Performance | [references/en/arkts-high-performance-programming.md](references/en/arkts-high-performance-programming.md) |\r\n| More Cases | [references/en/arkts-more-cases.md](references/en/arkts-more-cases.md) |\r\n\r\n## Workflows\r\n\r\n### 1. Syntax Questions\r\n\r\n```\r\nUser Question -> Identify Question Type -> Consult Documentation -> Provide Code Example\r\n```\r\n\r\n**Common Syntax Questions**:\r\n- Variable declaration -> Use `let`/`const` with explicit type or inference\r\n- Function definition -> Supports optional parameters, defaults, rest parameters,\r\n  arrow functions\r\n- Classes and interfaces -> Must initialize fields, supports inheritance and\r\n  implementation\r\n- Generics -> Supports constraints and default values\r\n- Null safety -> Nullable types ((T | null)), non-null assertion ((!)), optional\r\n  chaining ((?.))\r\n\r\n### 2. TypeScript Migration\r\n\r\n```\r\nIdentify TS Code -> Check Incompatible Features -> Consult Migration Rules -> Provide ArkTS Alternative\r\n```\r\n\r\n**Key Migration Rules Quick Reference**:\r\n\r\n| TypeScript | ArkTS Alternative |\r\n|------------|-------------------|\r\n| `var x` | `let x` |\r\n| `any`/`unknown` | Specific types |\r\n| `{n: 42}` object literal | Define class/interface first |\r\n| `[index: T]: U` index signature | `Record<T, U>` |\r\n| `A & B` intersection type | `interface C extends A, B` |\r\n| `function(){}` function expression | `() => {}` arrow function |\r\n| `<Type>value` type assertion | `value as Type` |\r\n| Destructuring `[a, b] = arr` | Individual access `arr[0]`, `arr[1]` |\r\n| `for..in` | `for` loop or `for..of` |\r\n| Constructor parameter properties | Explicit field declaration |\r\n\r\n### 3. Performance Optimization\r\n\r\n```\r\nAnalyze Code -> Identify Performance Issues -> Consult Optimization Guide -> Provide Solutions\r\n```\r\n\r\n**High-Performance Programming Key Points**:\r\n\r\n- **Declarations**: Use `const` for invariants; avoid mixing integer and float\r\n- **Loops**: Extract loop invariants; avoid numeric overflow\r\n- **Functions**: Parameter passing preferred over closures; avoid optional\r\n  parameters\r\n- **Arrays**: Use TypedArray for numeric values; avoid sparse arrays and union\r\n  type arrays\r\n- **Exceptions**: Avoid throwing in loops; use return values instead\r\n\r\n### 4. Compile Error Resolution\r\n\r\n```\r\nGet Error Message -> Search Migration Rules -> Find Related Case -> Provide Fix\r\n```\r\n\r\n## Common Questions\r\n\r\n### Q: How to handle JSON.parse return value?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Error\r\nlet data = JSON.parse(str);\r\n\r\n// Correct\r\nlet data: Record<string, Object> = JSON.parse(str);\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to define object types?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// TypeScript syntax (not supported in ArkTS)\r\ntype Person = { name: string, age: number }\r\n\r\n// ArkTS syntax\r\ninterface Person {\r\n  name: string;\r\n  age: number;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// Using object literal\r\nlet p: Person = { name: 'John', age: 25 };\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to replace globalThis?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Error\r\nglobalThis.value = 'xxx';\r\n\r\n// Use singleton pattern\r\nexport class GlobalContext {\r\n  private constructor() {}\r\n  private static instance: GlobalContext;\r\n  private _objects = new Map<string, Object>();\r\n\r\n  public static getContext(): GlobalContext {\r\n    if (!GlobalContext.instance) {\r\n      GlobalContext.instance = new GlobalContext();\r\n    }\r\n    return GlobalContext.instance;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  getObject(key: string): Object | undefined {\r\n    return this._objects.get(key);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  setObject(key: string, value: Object): void {\r\n    this._objects.set(key, value);\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to handle error types in catch?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Error\r\ntry {} catch (e: BusinessError) {}\r\n\r\n// Correct\r\ntry {} catch (error) {\r\n  let e: BusinessError = error as BusinessError;\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to use Record type?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// TypeScript index signature\r\nfunction foo(data: { [key: string]: string }) {}\r\n\r\n// ArkTS Record\r\nfunction foo(data: Record<string, string>) {}\r\n\r\n// Usage example\r\nlet map: Record<string, number> = {\r\n  'John': 25,\r\n  'Mary': 21,\r\n};\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to replace constructor signatures with factory functions?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// TypeScript constructor signature\r\ntype ControllerCtor = {\r\n  new (value: string): Controller;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ArkTS factory function\r\ntype ControllerFactory = () => Controller;\r\n\r\nclass Menu {\r\n  createController: ControllerFactory = () => {\r\n    return new Controller('default');\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n## Prohibited Standard Library APIs\r\n\r\nThe following are prohibited in ArkTS:\r\n\r\n- **Global**: `eval`\r\n- **Object**: `__proto__`, `defineProperty`, `freeze`, `getPrototypeOf`, etc.\r\n- **Reflect**: `apply`, `construct`, `defineProperty`, etc.\r\n- **Proxy**: All handler methods\r\n\r\n## Build Scripts\r\n\r\nThe scripts directory provides quick compilation scripts for ArkTS projects\r\n(including dependency installation):\r\n\r\n| Platform | Script | Purpose |\r\n|----------|--------|---------|\r\n| macOS/Linux | Install dependencies (`ohpm install --all`)\r\n2. How would you like to proceed?\r\n   Options:\r\n   - Continue retrying (attempt another fix)\r\n   - Manual intervention (I'll wait for your guidance)\r\n   - Skip compilation (proceed without verification)\r\n   ```\r\n\r\n4. **Error Reporting**: Always show the full compilation error output when failures occur.\r\n\r\n## Answer Guidelines\r\n\r\n1. **Prioritize code examples**: Show correct vs incorrect syntax comparison\r\n2. **Reference official documentation**: For detailed explanations, guide users to\r\n   consult corresponding documents in references/\r\n3. **Explain reasons**: Explain why ArkTS has this restriction (performance,\r\n   stability)\r\n4. **Provide alternatives**: For unsupported features, provide feasible\r\n  alternatives\r\n\r\n## License\r\n\r\nMIT License - see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)\r\n\r\n---\r\nname: hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever\r\ndescription: Retrieve grounded ArkTS references for pure non-UI ArkTS work and ArkTS API usage. --name-only | grep 'BuildProfile.ets')\r\n  ```\r\n\r\n# 开发时必须回答的验收维度\r\n\r\n`spec/acceptance.md` 里的每一条都要落到代码和自测里。这些维度各自都可能是独立检查点：\r\n\r\n| 维度 | 需要回答 |\r\n| --- | --- |\r\n| 入口 | rg -n '^export|@Builder|@Component' 'entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsCommon.ets'"}],"source":"unified_exec_startup","status":"completed","aggregated_output":"# Asynchronous Concurrency (Promise and Async/Await)\r\n<!--Kit: ArkTS-->\r\n<!--Subsystem: CommonLibrary-->\r\n<!--Owner: @wang_zhaoyong-->\r\n<!--Designer: @weng-changcheng-->\r\n<!--Tester: @kirl75; @zsw_zhushiwei-->\r\n<!--Adviser: @ge-yafang-->\r\n\r\n\r\nPromise and async/await are standard JavaScript asynchronous syntax, which provides the asynchronous concurrency capability. Asynchronous code is suspended and continues to execute later, ensuring that only one piece of code is executed at any given moment. The following are typical scenarios of asynchronous concurrency:\r\n\r\n- Non-blocking I/O operations: network requests, file reading and writing, and timers.\r\n\r\n- Lightweight tasks without CPU blocking: tasks with short execution times.\r\n\r\n- Clear logical dependencies: tasks with explicit order or parallel relationships.\r\n\r\nAsynchronous concurrency is a feature of programming languages that allows programs to continue executing other asynchronous code without waiting for certain operations to complete.\r\n\r\n## Promise\r\n\r\nA Promise is an object used to process asynchronous operations. It converts asynchronous operations into a style similar to synchronous operations for easier code writing and maintenance. A Promise manages different phases of asynchronous operations through the state mechanism. There are three states for a Promise: pending (in progress), fulfilled (completed, also called resolved), and rejected (failed). After creation, a Promise is in the pending state and transitions to the fulfilled or rejected state upon completion of the asynchronous operation.\r\n\r\nPromise provides the **then**, **catch**, and **finally** methods to register callback functions to handle the success or failure of asynchronous operations. When the Promise status changes, the callback function is added to the microtask queue for execution. The event loop mechanism ensures that microtasks are executed first after macro tasks are executed, thereby ensuring asynchronous scheduling of callback functions.\r\n\r\nThe most basic usage involves instantiating a Promise object through its constructor, passing in a function (usually named **executor**) with two parameters. The two parameters are **resolve** and **reject**, which represent the callback functions for the success and failure of the asynchronous operation, respectively.\r\nFor example, the code snippet below creates a Promise object and simulates an asynchronous operation:\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nconst promise: Promise<number> = new Promise((resolve: Function, reject: Function) => {\r\n  setTimeout(() => {\r\n    const randomNumber: number = Math.random();\r\n    if (randomNumber > 0.5) {\r\n      resolve(randomNumber);\r\n    } else {\r\n      reject(new Error('Random number is too small'));\r\n    }\r\n  }, 1000);\r\n})\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[promise_async_operation](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\n\r\nIn the above code, the **setTimeout** function simulates an asynchronous operation and generates a random number after 1 second. If the random number is greater than 0.5, the **resolve** callback is invoked with the random number; otherwise, the **reject** callback is invoked with an error object.\r\n\r\nAfter a Promise object is created, you can use the **then** and **catch** methods to specify callback functions for the fulfilled and rejected states. The **then** method can accept two parameters: one for handling the fulfilled state and the other for handling the rejected state. If only one parameter is passed in, the **then** method automatically calls the callback function when the Promise object state changes to **fulfilled**, with the result of the Promise object passed as a parameter. The **catch** method receives a callback function to handle failures, that is, capturing the Promise's transition to the rejected state or any exceptions thrown during the operation. The **finally** method receives a callback function, which will be executed regardless of the Promise's final state (fulfilled or rejected). The code snippet below shows the use of the **then** and **catch** methods.\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nconst promise: Promise<number> = new Promise((resolve: Function, reject: Function) => {\r\n  setTimeout(() => {\r\n    const randomNumber: number = Math.random();\r\n    if (randomNumber > 0.5) {\r\n      resolve(randomNumber);\r\n    } else {\r\n      reject(new Error('Random number is too small'));\r\n    }\r\n  }, 1000);\r\n})\r\n\r\n// Use the then method to define success and failure callbacks.\r\npromise.then((result: number) => {\r\n  console.info(`The number for success is ${result}`); // Executed on success.\r\n}, (error: Error) => {\r\n  console.error(error.message); // Executed on failure.\r\n}\r\n);\r\n\r\n// Use the then method to define a success callback and the catch method to define a failure callback.\r\npromise.then((result: number) => {\r\n  console.info(`Random number is ${result}`); // Executed on success.\r\n}).catch((error: Error) => {\r\n  console.error(error.message); // Executed on failure.\r\n});\r\n\r\n// Executed regardless of success or failure.\r\npromise.finally(() => {\r\n  console.info('finally complete');\r\n})\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[promise_then_catch_handling](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\n\r\nIn the preceding code, the callback function of the **then** method receives the success result of the Promise object and outputs the result to the console. If the Promise object enters the rejected state, the callback function of the **catch** method receives the error object and outputs the error object to the console.\r\n\r\n> **NOTE**\r\n>\r\n> When a Promise object is rejected and not handled by the **catch** method, it triggers the **globalUnhandledRejectionDetected** event. You can use the [errorManager.on('globalUnhandledRejectionDetected')](../reference/apis-ability-kit/js-apis-app-ability-errorManager.md#errormanageronglobalunhandledrejectiondetected18) API to listen for this event and globally capture unhandled Promise rejects.\r\n\r\n## Async/Await\r\n\r\nAsync/Await is syntactic sugar for handling asynchronous operations with Promises, making it easier and more readable to write asynchronous code. You can use the **async** keyword to declare an asynchronous function and the **await** keyword to wait for the resolution (fulfilled or rejected) of a Promise, and write asynchronous operation code in synchronous mode.\r\n\r\nAn **async** function returns a Promise object to implement an asynchronous operation. It can contain zero or more **await** keywords, pausing execution until the associated Promise completes its state transition (fulfilled/rejected). If an exception is thrown during function execution, the exception directly triggers the returned Promise to enter the rejected state, and the error object can be captured using the **catch** method or the second callback parameter of **then**.\r\n\r\nThe code snippet below uses async/await to simulate an asynchronous operation that returns a string after 3 seconds.\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nasync function myAsyncFunction(): Promise<string> {\r\n  const result: string = await new Promise((resolve: Function) => {\r\n    setTimeout(() => {\r\n      resolve('Hello, world!');\r\n    }, 3000);\r\n  });\r\n  console.info(result); // Output: Hello, world!\r\n  return result;\r\n}\r\n\r\n@Entry\r\n@Component\r\nstruct Index {\r\n  @State message: string = 'Hello World';\r\n  build() {\r\n    Row() {\r\n      Column() {\r\n        Text(this.message)\r\n          .fontSize(50)\r\n          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)\r\n          .onClick(async () => {\r\n            let res = await myAsyncFunction();\r\n            console.info('res is: ' + res);\r\n          })\r\n      }\r\n      .width('100%')\r\n    }\r\n    .height('100%')\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[async_await_sync_operation](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\n\r\nIn the preceding example code, **await** waits for the Promise to resolve and stores the resolved value in the **result** variable.\r\n\r\nSince you need to wait for the completion of the asynchronous operation, the entire operation must be wrapped in an **async** function and used with the **await** keyword. The **await** keyword is valid only in **async** functions. You can also use **try**/**catch** blocks to catch exceptions.\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nasync function myAsyncFunction(): Promise<void> {\r\n  try {\r\n    const result: string = await new Promise((resolve: Function) => {\r\n      resolve('Hello, world!');\r\n    });\r\n    console.info(result); // Output: Hello, world!\r\n  } catch (e) {\r\n    console.error(`Get exception: ${e}`);\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nmyAsyncFunction();\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[async_operation_error_handling_with_try_catch](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\n\r\n# Classes\r\n\r\nDefine custom reference types that combine data and behavior.\r\n\r\nClasses are one of the central building blocks of ArkTS programs. A class gives a type a name, defines the fields that every instance must contain, and attaches methods that operate on that data. When several values belong together and should move through a program as one unit, a class is often the clearest representation.\r\n\r\nClasses are especially important in ArkTS because object layout is explicit and stable. Fields are declared in the class body, instances are created through constructors, and the public API of the type is visible in one place. This differs from JavaScript's more dynamic object model, where properties and methods are often added or reassigned later.\r\n\r\n## Declaring a Class\r\n\r\nUse the `class` keyword to define a class:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass User {\r\n  name: string = '';\r\n  age: number = 0;\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nCreate an instance with `new`:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nlet user: User = new User();\r\nuser.name = 'Alice';\r\nuser.age = 20;\r\n```\r\n\r\nThe class declaration describes what every `User` instance contains. This is one of the key reasons classes work well in ArkTS: the structure is declared up front instead of being assembled dynamically at runtime.\r\n\r\n### Use Named Class Declarations\r\n\r\nIn ArkTS, a class is normally introduced with a named declaration:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Logger {\r\n  prefix: string = '[App]';\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nThis keeps the type easy to reference and makes the public model visible at the declaration site.\r\n\r\nJavaScript and TypeScript also allow class expressions such as:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Avoid JavaScript-style patterns such as:\r\n// const Logger = class { };\r\n```\r\n\r\nArkTS does not support class literals. Declare a named class explicitly instead.\r\n\r\n## Fields\r\n\r\nFields store per-instance data:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Point {\r\n  x: number = 0;\r\n  y: number = 0;\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nEach instance of `Point` has its own `x` and `y` values. Field declarations belong in the class definition itself, not somewhere else in the program.\r\n\r\n### Field Initializers\r\n\r\nField initializers provide default values:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass ConnectionOptions {\r\n  host: string = 'localhost';\r\n  port: number = 8080;\r\n  secure: boolean = false;\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nDefaults are useful when a field has an obvious starting value. They also make the initial state of the type easy to understand without reading the constructor first.\r\n\r\n### Fields Without Default Values\r\n\r\nSome fields are only known when the instance is created:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Product {\r\n  name: string;\r\n  price: number;\r\n\r\n  constructor(name: string, price: number) {\r\n    this.name = name;\r\n    this.price = price;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nIn this case, the constructor is responsible for assigning all required fields.\r\n\r\n## Creating Instances\r\n\r\nAn instance is created by calling the constructor with `new`:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Person {\r\n  name: string;\r\n\r\n  constructor(name: string) {\r\n    this.name = name;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nlet person: Person = new Person('Grace');\r\n```\r\n\r\nEach call to `new` creates a distinct object:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nlet first: Person = new Person('Ada');\r\nlet second: Person = new Person('Ada');\r\n\r\nconsole.info(first === second); // false\r\n```\r\n\r\nThe two instances may contain the same data, but they are still different objects.\r\n\r\nCreating a class instance with `new` is the standard and clearest ArkTS pattern. In particular, classes with custom constructors, methods, or `readonly` fields should be created through their constructor rather than treated like ordinary object literals.\r\n\r\n### Constructors Establish Valid State\r\n\r\nOne of the main jobs of a constructor is to guarantee that every new instance starts in a valid state:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Task {\r\n  title: string;\r\n  completed: boolean;\r\n\r\n  constructor(title: string) {\r\n    this.title = title;\r\n    this.completed = false;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nThis is better than creating an incomplete object and assigning required fields later.\r\n\r\n### Do Not Treat Classes as Loose Object Shapes\r\n\r\nIn JavaScript and TypeScript, it is common to think of a class as \"just an object with these fields\". In ArkTS, classes are more explicit than that: they define a named reference type with declared members and constructor-based initialization.\r\n\r\nFor example, this is the intended class style:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass ServerConfig {\r\n  host: string;\r\n  port: number;\r\n\r\n  constructor(host: string, port: number) {\r\n    this.host = host;\r\n    this.port = port;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nlet config: ServerConfig = new ServerConfig('localhost', 8080);\r\n54:One of the most important features of ArkTS is static typing. If a program is statically typed (all types are known at compile time), it is much easier to understand what data structures are used in the code. Since all types are known before the program actually runs, the compiler can verify code correctness, thereby eliminating many runtime type checks and improving performance.\r\n56:Therefore, the usage of the type **any** in ArkTS is prohibited.\r\n62:let res: any = some_api_function('hello', 'world');\r\n82:According to our measurements, **any** is already not welcome in TypeScript. It is used in approximately 1% of TypeScript codebases. Moreover, today's code linters (for example, ESLint) include a set of rules that prohibit the usage of **any**. Prohibiting **any** results in a strong positive impact on performance at the cost of low-effort code refactoring.\r\n92:It is noteworthy that many such operations are already prohibited by the TS compiler. However, it can still be \"tricked\" by, for example, using **as any** to convert the object type, disabling strict type check when compiling TS code, or ignoring type check using **@ts-ignore** in the code.\r\n94:In ArkTS, strict type check is not configurable. (original token count: 4448)\nTotal output lines: 348\n\n# Asynchronous Concurrency (Promise and Async/Await)\r\n<!--Kit: ArkTS-->\r\n<!--Subsystem: CommonLibrary-->\r\n<!--Owner: @wang_zhaoyong-->\r\n<!--Designer: @weng-changcheng-->\r\n<!--Tester: @kirl75; @zsw_zhushiwei-->\r\n<!--Adviser: @ge-yafang-->\r\n\r\n\r\nPromise and async/await are standard JavaScript asynchronous syntax, which provides the asynchronous concurrency capability. Asynchronous code is suspended and continues to execute later, ensuring that only one piece of code is executed at any given moment. The following are typical scenarios of asynchronous concurrency:\r\n\r\n- Non-blocking I/O operations: network requests, file reading and writing, and timers.\r\n\r\n- Lightweight tasks without CPU blocking: tasks with short execution times.\r\n\r\n- Clear logical dependencies: tasks with explicit order or parallel relationships.\r\n\r\nAsynchronous concurrency is a feature of programming languages that allows programs to continue executing other asynchronous code without waiting for certain operations to complete.\r\n\r\n## Promise\r\n\r\nA Promise is an object used to process asynchronous operations. It converts asynchronous operations into a style similar to synchronous operations for easier code writing and maintenance. A Promise manages different phases of asynchronous operations through the state mechanism. There are three states for a Promise: pending (in progress), fulfilled (completed, also called resolved), and rejected (failed). After creation, a Promise is in the pending state and transitions to the fulfilled or rejected state upon completion of the asynchronous operation.\r\n\r\nPromise provides the **then**, **catch**, and **finally** methods to register callback functions to handle the success or failure of asynchronous operations. When the Promise status changes, the callback function is added to the microtask queue for execution. The event loop mechanism ensures that microtasks are executed first after macro tasks are executed, thereby ensuring asynchronous scheduling of callback functions.\r\n\r\nThe most basic usage involves instantiating a Promise object through its constructor, passing in a function (usually named **executor**) with two parameters. The two parameters are **resolve** and **reject**, which represent the callback functions for the success and failure of the asynchronous operation, respectively.\r\nFor example, the code snippet below creates a Promise object and simulates an asynchronous operation:\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nconst promise: Promise<number> = new Promise((resolve: Function, reject: Function) => {\r\n  setTimeout(() => {\r\n    const randomNumber: number = Math.random();\r\n    if (randomNumber > 0.5) {\r\n      resolve(randomNumber);\r\n    } else {\r\n      reject(new Error('Random number is too small'));\r\n    }\r\n  }, 1000);\r\n})\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[promise_async_operation](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\n\r\nIn the above code, the **setTimeout** function simulates an asynchronous operation and generates a random number after 1 second. If the random number is greater than 0.5, the **resolve** callback is invoked with the random number; otherwise, the **reject** callback is invoked with an error object.\r\n\r\nAfter a Promise object is created, you can use the **then** and **catch** methods to specify callback functions for the fulfilled and rejected states. The **then** method can accept two parameters: one for handling the fulfilled state and the other for handling the rejected state. If only one parameter is passed in, the **then** method automatically calls the callback function when the Promise object state changes to **fulfilled**, with the result of the Promise object passed as a parameter. The **catch** method receives a callback function to handle failures, that is, capturing the Promise's transition to the rejected state or any exceptions thrown during the operation. The **finally** method receives a callback function, which will be executed regardless of the Promise's final state (fulfilled or rejected). The code snippet below shows the use of the **then** and **catch** methods.\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nconst promise: Promise<number> = new Promise((resolve: Function, reject: Function) => {\r\n  setTimeout(() => {\r\n    const randomNumber: number = Math.random();\r\n    if (randomNumber > 0.5) {\r\n      resolve(randomNumber);\r\n    } else {\r\n      reject(new Error('Random number is too small'));\r\n    }\r\n  }, 1000);\r\n})\r\n\r\n// Use the then method to define success and failure callbacks.\r\npromise.then((result: number) => {\r\n  console.info(`The number for success is ${result}`); // Executed on success.\r\n}, (error: Error) => {\r\n  console.error(error.message); // Executed on failure.\r\n}\r\n);\r\n\r\n// Use the then method to define a success callback and the catch method to define a failure callback.\r\npromise.then((result: number) => {\r\n  console.info(`Random number is ${result}`); // Executed on success.\r\n}).catch((error: Error) => {\r\n  console.error(error.message); // Executed on failure.\r\n});\r\n\r\n// Executed regardless of success or failure.\r\npromise.finally(() => {\r\n  console.info('finally complete');\r\n})\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[promise_then_catch_handling](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\n\r\nIn the preceding code, the callback function of the **then** method receives the success result of the Promise object and outputs the result to the console. If the Promise object enters the rejected state, the callback function of the **catch** method receives the error object and outputs the error object to the console.\r\n\r\n> **NOTE**\r\n>\r\n> When a Promise object is rejected and not handled by the **catch** method, it triggers the **globalUnhandledRejectionDetected** event. You can use the [errorManager.on('globalUnhandledRejectionDetected')](../reference/apis-ability-kit/js-apis-app-ability-errorManager.md#errormanageronglobalunhandledrejectiondetected18) API to listen for this event and globally capture unhandled Promise rejects.\r\n\r\n## Async/Await\r\n\r\nAsync/Await is syntactic sugar for handling asynchronous operations with Promises, making it easier and more readable to write asynchronous code. You can use the **async** keyword to declare an asynchronous function and the **await** keyword to wait for the resolution (fulfilled or rejected) of a Promise, and write asynchronous operation code in synchronous mode.\r\n\r\nAn **async** function returns a Promise object to implement an asynchronous operation. It can contain zero or more **await** keywords, pausing execution until the associated Promise completes its state transition (fulfilled/rejected). If an exception is thrown during function execution, the exception directly triggers the returned Promise to enter the rejected state, and the error object can be captured using the **catch** method or the second callback parameter of **then**.\r\n\r\nThe code snippet below uses async/await to simulate an asynchronous operation that returns a string after 3 seconds.\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nasync function myAsyncFunction(): Promise<string> {\r\n  const result: string = await new Promise((resolve: Function) => {\r\n    setTimeout(() => {\r\n      resolve('Hello, world!');\r\n    }, 3000);\r\n  });\r\n  console.info(result); // Output: Hello, world!\r\n  return result;\r\n}\r\n\r\n@Entry\r\n@Component\r\nstruct Index {\r\n  @State message: string = 'Hello World';\r\n  build() {\r\n    Row() {\r\n      Column() {\r\n        Text(this.message)\r\n          .fontSize(50)\r\n        …648 tokens truncated…k well in ArkTS: the structure is declared up front instead of being assembled dynamically at runtime.\r\n\r\n### Use Named Class Declarations\r\n\r\nIn ArkTS, a class is normally introduced with a named declaration:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Logger {\r\n  prefix: string = '[App]';\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nThis keeps the type easy to reference and makes the public model visible at the declaration site.\r\n\r\nJavaScript and TypeScript also allow class expressions such as:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Avoid JavaScript-style patterns such as:\r\n// const Logger = class { };\r\n```\r\n\r\nArkTS does not support class literals. Declare a named class explicitly instead.\r\n\r\n## Fields\r\n\r\nFields store per-instance data:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Point {\r\n  x: number = 0;\r\n  y: number = 0;\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nEach instance of `Point` has its own `x` and `y` values. Field declarations belong in the class definition itself, not somewhere else in the program.\r\n\r\n### Field Initializers\r\n\r\nField initializers provide default values:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass ConnectionOptions {\r\n  host: string = 'localhost';\r\n  port: number = 8080;\r\n  secure: boolean = false;\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nDefaults are useful when a field has an obvious starting value. They also make the initial state of the type easy to understand without reading the constructor first.\r\n\r\n### Fields Without Default Values\r\n\r\nSome fields are only known when the instance is created:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Product {\r\n  name: string;\r\n  price: number;\r\n\r\n  constructor(name: string, price: number) {\r\n    this.name = name;\r\n    this.price = price;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nIn this case, the constructor is responsible for assigning all required fields.\r\n\r\n## Creating Instances\r\n\r\nAn instance is created by calling the constructor with `new`:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Person {\r\n  name: string;\r\n\r\n  constructor(name: string) {\r\n    this.name = name;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nlet person: Person = new Person('Grace');\r\n```\r\n\r\nEach call to `new` creates a distinct object:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nlet first: Person = new Person('Ada');\r\nlet second: Person = new Person('Ada');\r\n\r\nconsole.info(first === second); // false\r\n```\r\n\r\nThe two instances may contain the same data, but they are still different objects.\r\n\r\nCreating a class instance with `new` is the standard and clearest ArkTS pattern. In particular, classes with custom constructors, methods, or `readonly` fields should be created through their constructor rather than treated like ordinary object literals.\r\n\r\n### Constructors Establish Valid State\r\n\r\nOne of the main jobs of a constructor is to guarantee that every new instance starts in a valid state:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Task {\r\n  title: string;\r\n  completed: boolean;\r\n\r\n  constructor(title: string) {\r\n    this.title = title;\r\n    this.completed = false;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\nThis is better than creating an incomplete object and assigning required fields later.\r\n\r\n### Do Not Treat Classes as Loose Object Shapes\r\n\r\nIn JavaScript and TypeScript, it is common to think of a class as \"just an object with these fields\". In ArkTS, classes are more explicit than that: they define a named reference type with declared members and constructor-based initialization.\r\n\r\nFor example, this is the intended class style:\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass ServerConfig {\r\n  host: string;\r\n  port: number;\r\n\r\n  constructor(host: string, port: number) {\r\n    this.host = host;\r\n    this.port = port;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nlet config: ServerConfig = new ServerConfig('localhost', 8080);\r\n54:One of the most important features of ArkTS is static typing. If a program is statically typed (all types are known at compile time), it is much easier to understand what data structures are used in the code. Since all types are known before the program actually runs, the compiler can verify code correctness, thereby eliminating many runtime type checks and improving performance.\r\n56:Therefore, the usage of the type **any** in ArkTS is prohibited.\r\n62:let res: any = some_api_function('hello', 'world');\r\n82:According to our measurements, **any** is already not welcome in TypeScript. It is used in approximately 1% of TypeScript codebases. Moreover, today's code linters (for example, ESLint) include a set of rules that prohibit the usage of **any**. Prohibiting **any** results in a strong positive impact on performance at the cost of low-effort code refactoring.\r\n92:It is noteworthy that many such operations are already prohibited by the TS compiler. However, it can still be \"tricked\" by, for example, using **as any** to convert the object type, disabling strict type check when compiling TS code, or ignoring type check using **@ts-ignore** in the code.\r\n94:In ArkTS, strict type check is not configurable. ArkTS enforces strict type check and prohibits the use of **any** and **@ts-ignore** in the code.\r\n112:delete (p1 as any).x;  // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\r\n114:// Class Point does not define any property named `z`, and it is impossible to add it while the program runs.\r\n117:(p2 as any).z = 'Label';   // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\r\n122:(p3 as any)[prop] = p3.x; // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\r\n125:// It is guaranteed that all Point objects have properties x and y of type number, so assigning a value of any other type is impossible:\r\n128:(p4 as any).x = 'Hello!'; // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\r\n203:- **T** and **U** are not related by inheritance or any common interface, but they are \"somewhat equivalent\" since they have the same **public** API, and so the answer to both questions above is \"yes\".\r\n204:- **T** and **U** are not related by inheritance or any common interface, and always must be considered as totally different types, and so the answer to both questions above is \"no\".\r\n212:So since functionally correct and performant implementation requires taking that many aspects into account, the support to this feature is postponed. The ArkTS team is ready to reconsider based on real-world scenarios and feedback. More cases and suggested workarounds can be found in [Recipes](#recipes).\r\n312:Names for all types (classes, interfaces, and enums) and namespaces must be unique and distinct from other names such as, variable names, and function names.\r\n385:### Use Explicit Types Instead of any or unknown\r\n387:**Rule:** arkts-no-any-unknown\r\n393:ArkTS does not support the types **any** and **unknown**. Specify types explicitly.\r\n398:let value1: any\r\n402:let value2: unknown\r\n550:interface StringArray {\r\n586:interface Identity {\r\n591:interface Contact {\r\n602:interface Identity {\r\n607:interface Contact {\r\n612:interface Employee extends Identity,  Contact {}\r\n628:interface ListItem {\r\n644:interface testListItem {\r\n747:ArkTS does not allow constructor signatures to be defined in interfaces. Use common functions or methods instead.\r\n752:interface I {\r\n764:interface I {\r\n791:ArkTS does not support dynamic field declaration and access. Access only those class fields that are either declared in the class, or accessible via inheritance. Accessing any other fields is prohibited, and causes compile-time errors.\r\n848:console.info(person.unknownProperty); // Compile-time error\r\n862:Currently, ArkTS does not support structural typing. This means that the compiler cannot compare **public** APIs of two types and decide whether they are identical. Use other mechanisms (inheritance, interfaces, or type aliases) instead.\r\n867:interface I1 {\r\n5:export interface SelectOption {\r\n9:export interface SettingsSectionItem {\r\n15:export interface ErrorObject {\r\n21:export function formatError(e: Error | ErrorObject | string | number | boolean): string {\r\n"}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a143bb-a1b8-75e2-90e9-1b83c2d034c4","create_time":1792137823.9361875}},"metadata":{"client_authored":false,"fallback_token_limit_override":12000}}

rg -n -A5 -B2 '@Builder' 'entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsCommon.ets'; Get-Content -Raw 'AGENTS.md' | Select-Object -Last 1"}],"source":"unified_exec_startup","status":"completed","aggregated_output":"entry/src/main/ets/components\\ClickableText.ets-132- */\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\ClickableText.ets:133:export function buildClickableText(\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\ClickableText.ets-134-  text: string,\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\ClickableText.ets-135-  fontSize: number = 14,\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\ClickableText.ets-136-  fontColor: ResourceColor = DesignTokens.Colors.GRAY_800,\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\ClickableText.ets-137-  wordColor: ResourceColor = DesignTokens.Colors.PRIMARY,\r\n--\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\GlassCard.ets-14-\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\GlassCard.ets:15:export class GlassCardConfig {\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\GlassCard.ets-16-  style: GlassCardStyle;\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\GlassCard.ets-17-  padding: number;\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\GlassCard.ets-18-  enableGradient: boolean;\r\nentry/src/main/ets/components\\GlassCard.ets-19-  gradientColors: Array<[ResourceColor, number]>;\r\n# HarmonyOS NEXT 开发核心规则与最佳实践\r\n\r\n本文档基于 Huawei 开发者官方文档及社区最佳实践整理，适用于 HarmonyOS NEXT (API 12+) 开发。\r\n\r\n## 1. ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\r\n\r\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\r\n\r\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\r\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\r\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\r\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\r\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\r\n\r\n### 1.2 语法限制\r\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\r\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\r\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\r\n\r\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\r\n\r\n### 2.1 组件化设计\r\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\r\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\r\n\r\n### 2.2 状态管理\r\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\r\n- **装饰器选择**：\r\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\r\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\r\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\r\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\r\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享。\r\n- **更新机制**：状态变量必须通过赋值更新，不要直接修改对象属性（除非使用 `@Observed` 和 `@ObjectLink` 处理嵌套对象）。\r\n\r\n### 2.3 布局与样式\r\n- **单位**：统一使用 `vp` (虚拟像素) 和 `fp` (字体像素)，禁止硬编码 `px`。\r\n- **布局性能**：\r\n  - 减少布局嵌套层级（特别是 `Stack` 和 `Flex` 的深层嵌套）。\r\n  - 优先使用 `RelativeContainer` 替代复杂的嵌套布局。\r\n  - 列表渲染必须使用 `LazyForEach`，并提供唯一的 `keyGenerator`，避免全量重绘。\r\n- **自适应**：使用断点 (`GridRow`/`GridCol`) 和媒体查询适配多设备屏幕。\r\n\r\n## 3. 性能优化指南\r\n\r\n### 3.1 渲染性能\r\n- **LazyForEach**：长列表数据必须使用 `LazyForEach` 加载，配合 `cachedCount` 预加载。\r\n- **条件渲染**：频繁切换显隐建议使用 `visibility` 属性控制，而非 `if/else`（后者会触发生命周期）。\r\n- **图片优化**：加载大图时使用 `Image` 组件的 `sourceSize` 属性进行解码尺寸裁剪，避免内存浪费。\r\n\r\n### 3.2 并发与异步\r\n- **主线程减负**：耗时操作（IO、复杂计算、网络请求）必须移至后台线程。\r\n- **TaskPool**：优先使用 `TaskPool` 处理短时任务，系统会自动管理线程生命周期。\r\n- **Worker**：适用于长时间运行的后台任务。\r\n- **Promise**：异步操作统一使用 Promise 或 async/await，避免回调地狱。\r\n\r\n### 3.3 内存管理\r\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\r\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\r\n\r\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\r\n\r\n### 4.1 目录结构\r\n```text\r\nentry/src/main/ets/\r\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\r\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\r\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\r\n├── utils/          # 工具类\r\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\r\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\r\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\r\n```\r\n\r\n### 4.2 命名规范\r\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\r\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\r\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., `MAX_RETRY_COUNT`)\r\n- **文件命名**：与主要导出内容一致，组件文件通常 PascalCase，工具文件 camelCase。\r\n\r\n### 4.3 Kit 使用\r\n- 优先使用 HarmonyOS 内置 Kit (如 `ArkData` 用于数据库, `NetworkKit` 用于网络, `ArkUI` 用于界面)。\r\n- 引入第三方库前需确认其是否支持 HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS 兼容性)。\r\n\r\n## 5. 安全与隐私\r\n\r\n- **权限最小化**：仅申请业务必须的权限 (`module.json5`)。\r\n- **用户授权**：运行时敏感权限必须向用户动态申请。\r\n- **数据安全**：\r\n  - 敏感数据（Token、密码）存储使用 `WebDavCrypto` 或系统级 `KeyStore`。\r\n  - 本地数据库优先使用 `RdbStore` 或 `Preferences` 并加密。\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 本题自动调度\r\n\r\n题号：vg-spec13\r\n\r\n本题根目录：D:/HCUP/vg-spec13\r\n\r\n主 Agent 开始/继续作答时加载 `D:/HarmonyDev/codex/skills/harmony-task-flow/SKILL.md`，读取 workflow/state.json，调度四个角色并按失败证据回退。\r\n\r\n子 Agent 仅完成收到的派工，不自行成为调度者或创建子 Agent。仅使用本题 inputs、project 和记录；禁止其他题工程及相关上游修复历史。\r\n\r\n## HCUP 工作区布局与阶段\r\n\r\n本题工程根就是当前目录；workflow/state.json 的 project 指向当前目录，不要再创建 project 子目录，也不要使用 Skill 示例中的另一套工程路径。\r\n\r\n本题需求读取 spec/requirement.md，元数据读取 spec/metadata.json；inputs/ 保留原始输入副本。公共资源只读访问 ../common/，不得访问其他赛题目录。\r\n\r\n开始构建或设备命令前加载 D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1。\r\n\r\n本次仅完成独立工程准备；尚未分析需求、设计方案或实现功能。正式作答从本目录的新会话开始，登记新会话后再按四角色流程推进。\r\n\r\n初始化总览会话也包含公共环境、官方示例与其他题的工程准备内容，不能将其视为本题功能开发证据；后续需求和编码角色不要读取该总览会话作为实现参考。\r\n\r\n","exit_code":0,"duration":{"secs":0,"nanos":395878000}},"started_at_ms":1792137942756,"completed_at_ms":1792137943152}}

ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\r\n\r\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\r\n\r\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\r\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\r\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\r\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\r\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\r\n\r\n### 1.2 语法限制\r\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\r\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\r\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\r\n\r\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\r\n\r\n### 2.1 组件化设计\r\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\r\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\r\n\r\n### 2.2 状态管理\r\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\r\n- **装饰器选择**：\r\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\r\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\r\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\r\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\r\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享…365 tokens truncated…调地狱。\r\n\r\n### 3.3 内存管理\r\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\r\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\r\n\r\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\r\n\r\n### 4.1 目录结构\r\n```text\r\nentry/src/main/ets/\r\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\r\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\r\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\r\n├── utils/          # 工具类\r\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\r\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\r\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\r\n```\r\n\r\n### 4.2 命名规范\r\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\r\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\r\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., `MAX_RETRY_COUNT`)\r\n- **文件命名**：与主要导出内容一致，组件文件通常 PascalCase，工具文件 camelCase。\r\n\r\n### 4.3 Kit 使用\r\n- 优先使用 HarmonyOS 内置 Kit (如 `ArkData` 用于数据库, `NetworkKit` 用于网络, `ArkUI` 用于界面)。\r\n- 引入第三方库前需确认其是否支持 HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS 兼容性)。\r\n\r\n## 5. 安全与隐私\r\n\r\n- **权限最小化**：仅申请业务必须的权限 (`module.json5`)。\r\n- **用户授权**：运行时敏感权限必须向用户动态申请。\r\n- **数据安全**：\r\n  - 敏感数据（Token、密码）存储使用 `WebDavCrypto` 或系统级 `KeyStore`。\r\n  - 本地数据库优先使用 `RdbStore` 或 `Preferences` 并加密。\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 本题自动调度\r\n\r\n题号：vg-spec13\r\n\r\n本题根目录：D:/HCUP/vg-spec13\r\n\r\n主 Agent 开始/继续作答时加载 `D:/HarmonyDev/codex/skills/harmony-task-flow/SKILL.md`，读取 workflow/state.json，调度四个角色并按失败证据回退。\r\n\r\n子 Agent 仅完成收到的派工，不自行成为调度者或创建子 Agent。仅使用本题 inputs、project 和记录；禁止其他题工程及相关上游修复历史。\r\n\r\n## HCUP 工作区布局与阶段\r\n\r\n本题工程根就是当前目录；workflow/state.json 的 project 指向当前目录，不要再创建 project 子目录，也不要使用 Skill 示例中的另一套工程路径。\r\n\r\n本题需求读取 spec/requirement.md，元数据读取 spec/metadata.json；inputs/ 保留原始输入副本。公共资源只读访问 ../common/，不得访问其他赛题目录。\r\n\r\n开始构建或设备命令前加载 D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1。\r\n\r\n本次仅完成独立工程准备；尚未分析需求、设计方案或实现功能。正式作答从本目录的新会话开始，登记新会话后再按四角色流程推进。\r\n\r\n初始化总览会话也包含公共环境、官方示例与其他题的工程准备内容，不能将其视为本题功能开发证据；后续需求和编码角色不要读取该总览会话作为实现参考。\r\n\r\n"}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a143bb-a1b8-75e2-90e9-1b83c2d034c4","create_time":1792137943.1648855}},"metadata":{"client_authored":false,"fallback_token_limit_override":12000}}

--- | --- | --- |\\n+| Idle/上轮终态 | 点击备份 | 同步 guard；复制点击时输入；递增 runId；发布 busy 和“正在备份到云端...” | Preparing |\\n+| Preparing | 当前输入无效 | 不调用真实 WebDAV，不退回旧配置；记录失败 | 最终清理 → 终态 |\\n+| Preparing | 其它经理操作正在运行 | 沿现有报忙/拒绝语义，不应用新设置、不抢占其 status | 最终清理 → 终态 |\\n+| Preparing | 设置应用/保存成功 | 继续等待原备份 Promise；如保留渲染让步，放在同一 try 内 | Running |\\n+| Preparing | 设置保存 false 或抛错 | 展示失败，禁止偷偷使用旧配置继续网络 | 最终清理 → 终态 |\\n+| Running | 预检/导出/加密/上传仍 pending | busy 保持；不允许第二轮；页面在场时 spinner 和进行文字保持 | Running |\\n+| Preparing/Running | 返回/切分区/后台 | 页面注销观察者；不取消、不重发、不改 busy | 原状态 |\\n+| Preparing/Running | 同进程重入 | 新观察者立即读取本轮快照；恢复 busy、spinner、文字和禁用入口 | 原状态 |\\n+| Running | 成功/返回失败/真实抛错 | 先等原 Promise 实际终结；记录成功或失败；经理与控制器 finally 清理 | 终态（busy=false） |\\n+| 任意进程内状态 | 进程终止再重启 | 新单例空闲；按既有初始化加载已保存配置，不重放手动任务 | Idle |\\n+\\n+必须维持：\\n+\\n+1. 控制器 busy 表示这一轮尚未终结，不能由 120 秒 `Promise.race` 的拒绝清空；备份不走此 race。底层 HTTP 既有 15/20 秒期限仍可形成真实失败终结，不新增 UI 软超时。\\n+2. 同一轮仅有一个真实备份任务。runId 只作进程内归属与防陈旧结果，不写入服务端数据或暴露测试后门；HTTP 多个目录请求不等于多轮任务。\\n+3. 构造配置、同步上锁、发布忙碌在任何 await 之前；页面快速连点和控制器 guard 双重兜底。\\n+4. `finally` 收尾涵盖配置应用/保存、渲染让步、预检、导出、加密、TaskPool 与网络的所有提前返回和抛错路径。经理只有在自己取得占用后才复位，拒绝其它占用的分支不得清掉别人的 status。\\n+5. 监听器回调异常应隔离记录，不能打断真实操作或阻止清理。发布的是替换后的新状态，组件 `@State` 通过赋值同步，不直接改其嵌套对象。\\n+6. promise 执行体只捕获纯 `WebDavSettings`、经理单例和控制器本身，不捕获页面 `this` 或 AbilityContext。组件调用后不保留一个在 await 完成时写已销毁 UI 的续体。\\n+\\n+## 5. 配置、保存与经理最小调整\\n+\\n+点击时按既有构造策略：endpoint/username trim；password/syncPassword 保留正文；remoteRoot trim，空白时默认 `/weiyu_sync`；沿既有 `requireRemoteRootExists=true`。控制器再复制为自己拥有的 `WebDavSettings`，不保存 `@Link` 的对象或返回自经理的可变引用。\\n+\\n+校验必须等效经理 `requireConfigured`：endpoint、username、password 的 trim 结果非空，syncPassword 的 trim 长度至少 4。校验用 trim 不代表保存密码时修改正文。invalid 当前输入不能回落到旧合法配置；分别覆盖已存在旧配置和首次配置两种前置。\\n+\\n+选择复用 `await manager.setSettings(snapshot)` 同时应用与尝试持久化；false/抛错作为本轮失败，不执行上传。不要把页面会改写 `webdavResult` 的 `saveWebDavSettings()` 闭包传入长生命周期控制器。`setSettings` 基线在 store 未就绪时会缓存并返回 true，控制器不能据此声称已经落盘；正常设置页初始化完成后自测重启加载成功，验证若发现未就绪竞态，再在本题初始化就绪边界作证据驱动调整，不先重构存储。Spec 不新增每次点击都必须持久化的独立要求。\\n+\\n+配置固定采取“两层最小保证”：\\n+\\n+- **页面层锁定**：`aggregateBusy = 本地其它动作 busy || 手动控制器 `WebDavSyncResult` 和真实上传实现。\\n+\\n+以上锁定证明的前提是本题当前仅两处设置写入点；若编码新增其它 setter/解锁编辑，必须改成预检也显式接收同轮快照或等效隔离，不能继续依赖此证明。\\n+\\n+## 6. 生命周期、渲染与稳定 id\\n+\\n+`aboutToAppear`
